If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!\n\n - All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.\n\n - One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.\n\n - Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.\n\n - Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.\n\n - Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.\n\nPosition Summary:\n\nAt Miovision, we are engineering the physical foundation of smart transportation, and we are looking for a visionary Vice President of Hardware Engineering to take the wheel during a pivotal growth inflection. Leading a 40-person multi-disciplinary organization, you will act as the master traffic controller for our entire hardware division—directing strategy, roadmaps, delivery, quality, and budget. Your mission is to execute on three parallel lanes without hitting a bottleneck: ensuring stability in predictable delivery, accelerating scalability as manufacturing volume ramps up, and driving strategic innovation to keep us miles ahead of the market. As the executive voice of hardware, you will ensure our physical products merge seamlessly with our software capabilities, bypassing gridlock and arriving to customers as a complete, market-leading offering. If you are ready to accelerate our hardware vision and keep our next-generation technology cruising in the fast lane, green means go!\n\n\n\nObjectives and Responsibilities:\n\n - Own hardware strategy, the multi-year roadmap, and the functional budget; represent hardware on the executive team.\n\n - Stability: hold predictable, high-quality delivery across multiple concurrent programs, protecting critical launch, certification, and volume commitments.\n\n - Scalability: scale the organization, operating model, and delivery capability as deployment volume ramps, growing throughput without sacrificing quality.\n\n - Strategic innovation: keep the multi-year roadmap ahead of the market and aligned to Miovision's growth and market-expansion goals.\n\n - Set priorities and make cross-program trade-off decisions; serve as the final escalation point for the function.\n\n - Own delivery outcomes (on time, at quality, at volume) across all programs, with day-to-day delivery cadence run through the Technical Program Manager.\n\n - Partner with the Sr. Director, Hardware Architecture & Advanced Development on system architecture, next-generation platforms, and horizon-two bets.\n\n - Partner with Product and Software Engineering to align roadmaps so hardware launches ship with the software and go-to-market they depend on.\n\n - Partner with Manufacturing Operations on NPI, supplier readiness, and the volume ramp; contract-manufacturer and manufacturing ownership sits with Manufacturing Operations.\n\n - Champion AI-enabled ways of working across hardware (design and verification, program management, and BOM and cost analysis) so the team delivers more per head as it scales.\n\n - Develop, retain, and succession-plan senior leaders; own the health of both the management and principal IC career tracks.\n\n - Establish a consistent operating rhythm: program reviews, communication cadence, and delivery metrics.\n\n - Own hardware talent strategy: hiring, leveling, and org design as the team scales.\n\n\n\nThe Ideal Profile:\n\n - You bring extensive experience in hardware product development, where you've also spent time successfully leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams (electrical, firmware, mechanical, quality).\n\n - You have a proven track record of leading a hardware organization through a significant business growth phase or massive volume inflection.\n\n - You have successfully shipped complex, connected hardware through full New Product Introduction (NPI) cycles directly into high-volume production, including deep experience managing CMs and ODMs.\n\n - You remain highly decisive when faced with ambiguity and wield exceptional executive communication skills to influence cross-functional stakeholders from the engineering floor to the boardroom.\n\n - You are a passionate developer of senior leaders, adept at building resilient organizational structures and mapping out both management and principal individual contributor career tracks.\n\n - You possess strong fluency and genuine excitement for applying modern AI tools to optimize and accelerate hardware engineering workflows.\n\nYour Rewards & Well-being:\nWe invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.\n\n - Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.\n\n - Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.\n\n - Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.\n\n - Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.\n\nSound like your next adventure? Reporting directly to the Product Director of Hardware, you will be the ultimate traffic controller for our physical product portfolio. We need a visionary who can expertly navigate the complex intersections of ambiguous market signals, engineering realities, and evolving field conditions. You will be the driving force that shifts our physical products from discrete sensing components into a fully connected, intelligent device platform. If you are ready to steer our hardware roadmap out of gridlock, build rugged devices that survive the wildest environments, and merge our physical technology seamlessly with our software ecosystem, green means go!</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Objectives and Responsibilities:</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Strategic Ownership:</strong> Take full accountability for the success and adoption metrics of our hardware products, defining exactly how they integrate into the broader hardware-software ecosystem.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Future-Proofing:</strong> Predict 1–3 year technology shifts, initiate de-risking projects, and distill complex market dynamics into a clear \"North Star\" for your portfolio.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Platform Design:</strong> Design field-ready, software-extensible platforms—not just point solutions—that proactively account for ruggedization, long refresh cycles, and frictionless installation.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Lifecycle Leadership:</strong> Build high-conviction business cases and manage the entire hardware lifecycle from concept and development through to launch and end-of-life.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Market Discovery:</strong> Establish a permanent rhythm of internal and external discovery to validate risky assumptions early and identify emerging opportunities in edge AI, compute, and sensing.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>High-Stakes Decision Making:</strong> Drive major architecture and platform investments, grounding decisions in performance constraints, supply chain exposure, industry standards, and strict P&amp;L goals.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cross-Functional Alignment:</strong> Successfully align Engineering, Operations, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams on unified release plans, expertly managing the complex interface between agile software and waterfall hardware development.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Industry Advocacy:</strong> Actively engage with industry standards bodies and working groups to stay ahead of regulatory requirements and represent our device platform strategy externally.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>The Ideal Profile:</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>The Strategic Veteran:</strong> You bring advanced product management experience, thriving in autonomy and ambiguity. You comfortably manage \"up and sideways,\" and know exactly how to say \"no\" strategically to protect your team’s focus and critical business needs.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>The Systems Thinker:</strong> You look beyond individual features to understand how sensors, edge compute, firmware, and cloud software form one cohesive product experience. You ensure that hardware decisions never constrain software evolution.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>The Field Hardware Expert:</strong> You have a proven track record of designing products for rugged, outdoor, or industrial environments. You deeply understand the trade-offs around environmental ratings, physical UI, installation UX, and hardware longevity.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>The User-Obsessed Explorer:</strong> You always start with the user and work backwards. You build continuous discovery loops to deeply understand pain points and validate assumptions with multi-modal data long before committing engineering resources.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>The Business Mind:</strong> You possess razor-sharp business acumen. You deeply understand financial levers like COGS and margins, and you know exactly how hardware unit economics tie into broader engineering and corporate sales goals.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>The B2G Master:</strong> You understand the unique complexities of how government agencies, municipalities, and enterprise buyers evaluate and procure infrastructure hardware, successfully maneuvering through long sales cycles and tight procurement constraints.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Your Rewards &amp; Well-being:</strong><br />We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.</p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Comprehensive Coverage: </strong>Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Financial Future:</strong> Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Time to Recharge:</strong> Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Work &amp; Life Support: </strong>We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.</p></li></ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Sound like your next adventure? The Data Whisperer: You are fiercely metric-focused with strong proficiency in marketing analytics tools, SQL/BI platforms (like PowerBI), and building multi-touch attribution models to drive meaningful insights.\n\n -
